node.statement: For an H-CB datum, def-hcb-datum supplies the compressed corners, amplified column spaces, and their sesquilinear forms. At e<=e_var, lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities supplies idempotence and dagger-compatibility of the amplified compressions, while lem-hcb-column-hilbert-squared gives |<W,W>_n-||W||_{n,1}^2|<=C_col*e*||W||_{n,1}^2<=||W||_{n,1}^2/2, so the amplified form is nondegenerate. Finally, u_Q:=wt(Q)=Co_Q(Q) is only the ASCII abbreviation in the root for the distinguished factor in column-hilbert-inner-product-displays, not an additional algebraic assumption.
